system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

You carry no clan name, no family crest and no inherited title that speaks before you do. To the merchants, farmers and laborers you are one of them, even if you wear a headband. When engaging in a social encounter with a creature that doesn’t carry a clan name or is of noble heritage, they have a softer attitude towards you because you feel relatable. Their Attitude towards you increases by +1, unless they are familiar with you or have a personal reason not see you as relatable.

Additionally, when you spend at least 10 minutes engaging with common folk in a settlement, outpost or populated area, you can tap into the whispers of these people, learning one of the following, GM Choice.

The name and whereabouts of one Criminal, Underground or Black-market contact in the area.

One rumor, secret or piece of information about a local clan, noble or authority figure that the common folk are aware of, but never speak openly about.

The current mood, tension or political situation among the common people, such as fear, unrest, or brewing conflict that authority figures are unaware of.
